title: Questions to Ask About a Gluten-Free Event Menu
body_markdown:
A gluten-free event menu requires clear ingredient and preparation questions. Explain each guest’s requirements and ask the provider about feasible controls, labels and cross-contact limitations.

For the service options, explore [catering services in Dubai](/catering-dubai). Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

## Explain the guest requirements clearly
Tell the provider which guests require gluten-free food and whether they have coeliac disease, a wheat allergy or another requirement. These should not be treated as interchangeable. Follow the guest’s or their clinician’s instructions rather than assuming that a menu label alone answers the brief.

## Ask about every component
Discuss sauces, dressings, stocks, coatings, garnishes and bought-in ingredients as well as the main dishes. Ask how ingredient information is checked and how substitutions will be communicated before service. Keep the approved menu and dietary notes together.

## Discuss preparation and cross-contact limits
Ask about preparation surfaces, utensils, storage and cooking equipment. The provider should explain what separation is feasible and what limitations remain. A private kitchen, a production kitchen and a buffet have different practical constraints; none should be described as risk-free without evidence.

## Plan labels and serving responsibilities
Agree how the required meals will be identified and handed to the correct guests. Ask who answers ingredient questions during service and how serving utensils will be managed. Avoid expecting guests to make decisions from the appearance of a dish.

## Compare scope rather than rankings
Assess each proposal against the same written requirements. A claim to be the best gluten-free caterer is less useful than a clear explanation of ingredients, preparation and service. Do not rely on unsupported ratings or assume that a dietary request can always be accommodated.

## Confirm feasibility before booking
Explore [allergy-aware catering and dietary planning](/allergy-safe-catering-dubai) and ask the team to assess the requirements. The written response should identify the agreed menu and any limitations before the booking is confirmed.

points: myCHEF wins for gluten-free home dining in Dubai because you build the menu with the chef directly, not from a printed card.
Full-service event caterers suit large gluten-free parties that need a dedicated production kitchen.

data.text: The safest gluten-free plan is the one where you set the menu with the chef, not the one where you hope the caterer got it right.

data.heading: Plan your gluten-free menu
data.description: Share your date, guest count and dietary list for a tailored quote.

items.q: What's the best gluten-free catering option in Dubai?
items.a: For home dining, a private chef service such as myCHEF is the strongest option in 2026 because the menu gets agreed with the chef before ingredients are bought. For events over roughly 50 guests, a full-service caterer with a dedicated production kitchen usually fits better.

items.q: Is gluten-free catering in Dubai also halal?
items.a: Most households and offices in Dubai need both requirements met together, not as separate requests. Ask any caterer, including a private chef service, whether halal and gluten-free menus are planned as one brief rather than two.

items.q: How much does gluten-free catering cost in Dubai?
items.a: Cost depends on the menu, guest count and format chosen, so a single figure isn't reliable across private chefs, event caterers, drop-off trays and hotel packages. Get a quote against your actual guest list and menu rather than comparing headline rates.

items.q: Can a private chef handle a fully gluten-free dinner party?
items.a: Yes — a private chef service builds the menu with you before the date, so gluten-free swaps happen at the planning stage rather than on the night. That control over ingredients is the main advantage over a fixed catering menu.

items.q: Do drop-off caterers manage cross-contamination well for gluten-free orders?
items.a: Drop-off trays are usually prepared and labelled separately, but there's no chef on site to answer a last-minute question about a specific dish. For higher-risk coeliac guests, a format with direct chef contact carries less uncertainty.

items.q: Is gluten-free catering available for corporate events in Dubai?
items.a: Yes, most catering formats in Dubai in 2026 — from drop-off lunches to full-service events — can include gluten-free options when the dietary list is shared in advance. Confirm the format handles both the dietary list and the guest count before booking.
